headline: Solvable but long: across 77 transactions on four cards, the documented rates, exclusions and round-down rule give exactly the ten gold disputes. Only the rounding document is missing from the required list.

issues.summary: The rounding rule that decides which rows count as errors lives in doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007, which is not listed in required_documents. The agent can still find it with KB search or grep in the default alltools configuration.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: Under a retrieval configuration that only shows required_documents (golden_retrieval / required_docs prompt), the agent never sees the rounding rule, so whether a row counts as a 1-point error depends on whichever convention the agent assumes.

solution_check: Recomputed all 77 transactions for f9bf8de0be. Rules: Diamond 5%; Business Platinum 4% Travel/Software/Media else 1.5%; Business Silver 10% Travel/Software with doc _005 exclusions, and no 2x promo because the account opened 06/10/2024, before the 2024-11-14 window; EcoCard 5x Green except Target/ThredUp; floor. Floor gives exactly the 10 gold rows with no false positives or misses, e.g. ffeede (Dell $1,849.99 excluded -> 1849, stored 18499), ba8b47 ('Target - Eco Collection' $145.67 -> 145, stored 728), 4f5e24 (ThredUp coded Green $78.34 -> 78, stored 391), and 30cb41 (Marriott Bonvoy $534.21 -> 5342, stored 10684). Round-half-up adds 26 one-point false positives. The gold replay matches itself.
prior_note: The prior Major assumed floor rounding was undocumented. Doc _007 documents it, and the seed follows it exactly, so only the Minor required_documents omission remains.
notes: The task needs an exclusion lookup on 'Target - Eco Collection' (the doc_ecocard_004 Target exclusion) and on Dell coded Software (the Business Silver hardware exclusion). Both are explicit in the docs. Business Platinum WeWork $450 at 1.5% = 675 is correct: the 0% WeWork exclusion belongs to Business Bronze only. No relaxed comparison in the verified scorer applies.
